# giscraft

QGIS-class GIS in pure Rust: clean-room 1:1 clone shell for QGIS muscle
memory, modern core, CLI + MCP first. Native egui app, SQLite project file,
Web Mercator canvas with tiles, live Overpass/Photon ingest.

- README: README.md (start here)
- Install: INSTALL.md (build from source; Rust + MSVC linker required)
- Onboarding: docs/ONBOARDING.md (smoke test, first live map)
- Tools (9 MCP tools): docs/TOOLS.md
- Config (`GISCRAFT_*` env): docs/CONFIGURATION.md
- Architecture (L1/L2/L3, command bus): docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Data ecosystem (sources, standards, where your maps go): docs/ECOSYSTEM.md
- QGIS wrappee + plugin strategy: docs/WRAPPEE.md, docs/plugins.md
- Dev gates (clippy deny unwrap/panic, 56 tests): docs/DEVELOPMENT.md, AGENTS.md

Status: pre-release, track A (native) working; track B webapp reserved.
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0.
